breakdown.description: It treats the specimen as semi-infinite, but the stated target depth of 0.8 mm exceeds the total thickness of the 0.5 mm foil.
breakdown.reason: The inconsistency was that 0.8 mm depth was impossible in a 0.5 mm foil while assuming semi-infinite behavior. The generated specification changes thickness to 5.0 mm, matching the ground truth, so 0.8 mm is now physically valid and compatible with the semi-infinite assumption.
